user_query: I'm curious about the background of a specific song and the meaning behind its lyrics. Can you provide me with the song details and lyrics using Shazam? Also, show me the comments related to this song from SongMeanings.

TaskList.description: Use Shazam to identify the song based on audio input and retrieve basic song details and lyrics.
Fetch comments and interpretations related to the song from the SongMeanings platform.
